**Interface** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public interface IPrinter
```

A printer that can accept print jobs.

Safe to use from several threads at once, for example to submit several jobs together.

## Properties

### Info

```csharp
PrinterInfo Info { get; }
```

Gets information about the printer, as read when the printer was looked up.

## Methods

### GetCapabilitiesAsync

```csharp
Task<PrinterCapabilities> GetCapabilitiesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Reads what the printer can do: paper sizes, duplex, colour, copies, orientation and paper sources.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the request.

**Returns**

The capabilities. Anything the print system doesn't report is left empty.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system or printer couldn't be asked.

### SubmitAsync

```csharp
Task<IPrintJob> SubmitAsync(PrintContent content, PrintOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Submits a document to the printer.

**Parameters**

- `content`: The document to print.
- `options`: How to print the document. Use [PrintOptions.Default](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#default) for printer defaults.
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the submission. Cancelling does not cancel a job once it has been accepted.

**Returns**

The submitted job, which can be used to follow its progress.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `content` or `options` is `null`.
- [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception): The printer cannot accept documents in the content's format.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system rejected or failed to accept the job.
